title: The Future of Audio

reader_summary.headline: What happens when we give creators of all kinds more tools, both for expression and for monetization and engagement?
reader_summary.overview: What happens when we give creators of all kinds more tools, both for expression and for monetization and engagement? And how does this play out in particular in the world of audio and podcasting? In this episode from October 2020, A16Z general partner Connie Chan and Spotify's chief R&D officer, Gustav Schoderstrum.

thesis: The episode discusses the future of audio by contrasting it with video, noting that while video combines sight and sound, audio offers unique engagement modes like foreground and background listening that allow users to multitask. The speakers argue that the audio industry has not yet adopted 21st-century monetization and interactivity models found in other media, despite a recent explosion in content and a new generation of users brought in by streaming services.
